checks: schema is safely rerunnable and creates private storage
anonymous cannot read ledger or call financial functions
unlisted authenticated account cannot load or save
authorized first load is an empty ledger
first atomic save advances revision once
stale revision never overwrites newer data
another allowed account sees no other owner ledger
direct update cannot bypass compare and swap
members cannot grant themselves another email
malformed data is rejected before writing
simultaneous writers produce one save and one conflict
old successful mutation stays idempotent after later changes
own private evidence can be read
evidence cannot be overwritten or deleted through the client role
revoking allowed email blocks existing authenticated access
engine: PostgreSQL 17; simulated Supabase auth claims and storage metadata
